name: Worktrunk
description: Installs the Worktrunk CLI (`wt` and `git-wt`) from official GitHub release assets, sets a container-safe system worktree-path default, and persists `~/.config/worktrunk` across devcontainers.

version.description: Version to install. Use "latest" for the most recent release, or specify a version like "0.69.2" or "v0.69.2".

tabCompletions.description: Install Worktrunk shell integration (tab completions and the `wt` directory-switching wrapper) for bash, zsh, and fish.
